UTAH.note: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.
Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

POR.note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.
Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Youngblood (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against Utah.

Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.
Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.

Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

CLE.note: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

MIN.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
